set.body:
Scope
Support new-row and partial-column inference without mislabeling nonlinear encoding as linear projection.

Acceptance criteria
- FittedProjection remains the linear operation; FittedLatentEncoder solves the declared convex code problem against fixed factors.
- Encoding accepts an explicit observation pattern and never infers missingness from zeros.
- Results include code, support, objective, decoded values, KKT/prox-gradient residual, and uniqueness status.
- Empty support, unseen categorical levels, incompatible domains, and non-identifiable codes are typed outcomes.
- Partial encoding matches analytic ridge/least-squares cases and an independent convex oracle.
- Dense/sparse mask equivalence and compatible-observation metamorphic tests pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar GLRM 2: certified partial latent encoding and decoding
